tagline.purpose: The company's own taglines, set as paragraphs.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Every UI transition: presses, underlines, reveals, the filter reflow.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Feedback on buttons, chips and cards.

motion.name: set-slip
motion.purpose: The home wall is set slip by slip once on load.

motion.name: reveal
motion.purpose: Sections rise once as they scroll into view; visible without JavaScript.

motion.name: filter-reflow
motion.purpose: The deal wall reflows when a filter changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action in a view.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; padding:0.85em 1.3em; background:#1d4266; color:#fafafa; font:600 17px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; border:0; border-radius:0; transition:background-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:#142f49; } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(0.97); }

components.name: Filter chip
components.description: A radio button styled as a square chip, with a count.
components.css: .ds-chip { position:relative; font:600 17px 'Schibsted Grotesk Variable', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-chip input { position:absolute; inset:0; opacity:0; margin:0; } .ds-chip span { display:inline-block; padding:0.6em 1em; background:#ffffff; color:#161514; } .ds-chip b { font-weight:400; color:#3a4856; margin-left:0.25em; } .ds-chip input:checked + span { background:#161514; color:#fafafa; } .ds-chip input:checked + span b { color:#cfcac4; }

narrative.overview: The site is built like a financial newspaper page that carries deal announcements. Every deal is a tombstone; the rest stays quiet, exact and flat.
keyCharacteristics: One grotesk, two lines per heading
Square corners, no lines, no shadows

rules.name: Blue field means deals
rules.body: The field and card colours only appear where deals are shown.

rules.name: Tone steps, not lines
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by background tone, never borders or shadows.

rules.name: Two lines at most
rules.body: Headings fit two lines at every width; long taglines are set as tagline paragraphs.

dos: Do keep every company name as real text.
Do use the company's own photos, large and square.
donts: Don't use the blue field outside deal regions.
Don't add borders, shadows, gradients or rounded corners.
Don't put small labels above headings.
Don't invent titles, quotes or numbers.
